fact: A contract award notification was issued on 2025-12-18 to Groupement LIBRE-TIC & CYBER-TECHS for four months of technical assistance to design and implement the public sector data governance framework under the World Bank-financed Public Sector Digital Governance Project (P174620).
title: AT pour la conception et la mise en oeuvre du cadre de gouvernance des donnees pour le secteur public (tous ensemble)
publisher: World Bank (award notice, republished by BidsFactory)
